title: Choose Saathi's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Inland Letter. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Inland Letter
options.lineage: India Post inland letter-cards and postmarks
options.thesis: Every step arrives like a letter from someone who cares: one clear message, then a postmark on exactly what to press.
materials: post-box red as the only accent
options.viewport: The phone app dimmed to blue-grey; a crisp double-ring postmark circles the one button to press; a white letter card at the opposite edge carries the line in large type; a red round Help seal sits at the side.
options.risk: Post imagery reads old-fashioned if the postmark gets ornamental instead of staying a clean double ring.

raised.raise: Caption text runs at one large size; rank comes only from weight and reversal, never from small print.
State is a mark, not a colour: the target is ringed, finished setup steps are cancelled with a postmark strike.
Close sits apart from Repeat behind deliberate empty space and stays outline-only.
Setup shows its whole extent as a row of PIN-code boxes, filled as each step is done.
One step owns each setup screen; nothing competes with it.
The step numeral is set huge against small labels; hierarchy by scale contrast alone.

options.label: Metro Wayfinding
options.lineage: Delhi Metro signage and line diagrams
options.thesis: Saathi guides like a station sign: one arrow, one destination, stacked in your language and English.
options.viewport: A sign-panel caption with a bold arrow aimed at the target; the target ringed like a station dot; setup laid out as a line diagram with stations.
options.risk: Transit wayfinding is where many 'clean and modern' guidance apps land; familiar by design.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetable on a light table
options.thesis: Raked glass slides on a lit goldenrod bed, one type size throughout.
options.risk: Raked containers and dense columns fight weak eyesight.
options.case: Fuses poorly: seniors don't know airline timetables, and raked type slows reading.
options.kept: One type size; rank by weight and reversal.

options.label: Event Circle Catalog
options.thesis: Stamp-sized cells, the chosen one circled in biro.
options.viewport: A packed grid with the target circled.
options.risk: Density is the opposite of what a confused senior needs.
options.case: Fuses poorly: unfamiliar world, dense grid hurts clarity.
options.kept: State shown by a mark: circled now, struck when done.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels with hairline seams and isolated destructive actions.
options.viewport: Panels over the app, accents for state only.
options.risk: Reads technical and cold to an older audience.
options.case: Fuses poorly: seniors don't identify with developer tools.
options.kept: Destructive action isolated by deliberate space.

options.label: Acetate Manual Tabs
options.thesis: Leaves over coloured boards, a stepped tab rail showing extent.
options.viewport: A leaf over a coloured board with a tab rail.
options.risk: Layered acetate muddies contrast for weak eyes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: unfamiliar artefact; layering costs legibility.
options.kept: A rail that shows the whole extent and where you are.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Flat colour lobes with coastlines that divide everything.
options.risk: Playful overshoot motion conflicts with calm, and with the clean brief.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful world contradicts the clean-and-modern brief.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Giant letterforms, tiny labels, scale contrast as hierarchy.
options.viewport: A giant glyph with a live axis readout.
options.risk: A specimen celebrates type, not the senior's task.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience link; the task disappears behind the type.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Material 3 assistant overlay: white cards, one accent, rounded everything, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A rounded white caption sheet, a circular highlight on the target, a floating action button for Help.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other assistant overlay by design.
